# Introduction

This is the introduction to **Transport Data Science**.

Transport Data Science is an exciting, interdisciplinary field that leverages computational methods, geographic information systems (GIS), and data science techniques to solve transport challenges.

## Why Transport Data Science?

The transport sector generates vast amounts of data, including:
- GPS tracks and mobile phone records
- Smart card and ticketing system data
- Traffic sensors and cameras
- OpenStreetMap and public transit schedules (GTFS)

Data science tools help transport planners and researchers make sense of this data to design more efficient, sustainable, and equitable transport systems.
